question_text: A 65-year-old man was picked up by the security personnel for voiding urine and defecating at an inappropriate place in the community. On questioning, he was making offensive remarks and behaving inappropriately. On physical examination, the physician observed an ataxic gait and amnesia. Initial urine drug screen is negative for any drugs of abuse. Which is the most likely pathological finding present in this patient?
